feats.title: Action Rush
feats.description: When an action point grants you an extra action, you may shift 2 squares as a free action immediately before or after that action.

feats.title: Avenging Opportunist
feats.description: The first time each encounter you bring your Oath of Enmity target to 0 hit points, gain an extra move action. Use it by the end of your next turn.

feats.title: Divine Perseverance
feats.description: A successful saving throw grants +2 to your next attack roll made by the end of your next turn.

feats.title: Human Beast Mastery
feats.description: Increase all of your beast companion's defenses by 1.

feats.title: Inspired Defense
feats.description: Inspiring Word also gives its target a +1 power bonus to all defenses through the start of your next turn.

feats.title: Invoke Resilience
feats.description: Using a divine encounter or daily attack power on your turn grants an ally within 10 squares a +1 power bonus to its next saving throw made by the end of your next turn.

feats.title: Rash Sneak Attack
feats.description: When dealing Sneak Attack damage, you may add 2 to the damage roll. Taking this bonus grants all enemies combat advantage against you through the end of your next turn.

feats.title: Reckless Curse
feats.description: You gain +1 to attacks against enemies under your Warlock's Curse. Those enemies also gain +1 to attacks against you.

feats.title: Risky Aegis
feats.description: After you use the immediate action of Swordmage Aegis against an enemy you marked, gain +2 to attack and damage rolls against it through the end of your next turn. It gains combat advantage against you through the end of its next turn.

feats.title: Rousing Voice
feats.description: An ally using Second Wind within 10 squares also gains temporary hit points equal to your Charisma.

feats.title: Shared Perseverance
feats.description: An ally granted a saving throw by one of your powers gains +1 to that save.

feats.title: Sideways Defense
feats.description: Adjacent allies gain +1 to all defenses against creatures you have marked.

feats.title: Wrath of the Forester
feats.description: If you have already used Nature's Wrath this turn, spending an action point for an extra action lets you use it once more before your turn ends.
